description_sq:
Shitet vile 2 kateshe me papafingo,me certificate pronesie ne Peze, siperfaqe 450 m2 dhe 700 m2 Truall bashke me Are dhe me certifikate pronesie.
• Kati perdhe me siperfaqe 105,2 m2 
• Kati pare me siperfaqe 157,8 m2 
• Papafingo me siperfaqe 23,4 m2
Jane dy vila dhe organizohen ne : kuzhine,sallon,3 dhoma gjumi,dy tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Vila eshte totalisht e investuar dhe e mobiluar me te gjitha bashkekohore,jane te gjitha punime te 2015,parket,kondicioner,lavastovilie,dere elektronike ,me kopesht rreth Viles dhe 3 vende parkimi.
Vila vlen per banim dhe shitet e mobiluar.
Cmimi i shitjes 300.000 euro
description_en: 2-storey villa with attic for sale, with certificate of ownership in Peze, surface area 450 m2 and 700 m2 of land with land and with certificate of ownership. • Ground floor with an area of ​​105.2 m2 • First floor with an area of ​​157.8 m2 • Attic with an area of ​​23.4 m2 There are two villas and they are organized in: kitchen, living room, 3 bedrooms, two toilets and 2 balconies. The villa is fully invested and furnished with all contemporary features, all work was done in 2015, parquet, air conditioning, washing machine, electronic door, with a garden around the villa and 3 parking spaces. The villa is suitable for living and is sold furnished. Selling price 300,000 euros
